title: Article cover: a full-height square colour field with one picture beside a column with category, date, a bold title, a serif deck and a byline
use: A news or essay cover; subject and field choose the picture.

field.note: the colour field behind the picture

subject.note: which picture: 0 hand-graph, 1 seedling, 2 book, 3 magnifier, 4 spark-hands, 5 path, 6 candles, 7 compass

title.default: 回测不是证明，是一份可以被复查的记录

deck.default: 我们把一次回测需要的数据口径、参数和随机种子放在同一份配置里，让别人能复现，也能反驳。

byline.default: 研究组 · 示例文章，文案为占位

relations: A 900 x 900 colour field at the left edge with the picture at 62% (about 560 units); the column starts at 980 and is 540 wide.
Category bold 14 with a date 14 regular after it; title bold sans 54 / 1.18 in up to three lines; deck serif 22 / 1.5 #3D3D3A in up to three lines; a hairline at 738 and the byline 15 #5E5D59 below.
decoration: The field and its picture with their line filter, the hairline; the text slots are the only measured content.

provenance.corpus: product-site kit (examples/brand-band-site-kit): our own original one-page site in Chinese in the brand-band grammar; all copy is a placeholder
provenance.experiment: styles/brand-band/style.json provenance (public pages measured privately in Chrome on 2026-11-21; never shipped); the pictures are our own code-drawn illustrations
provenance.method: The measured news article (bold sans title 35.9 / 40.9, serif body, a figure with radius 4) and the careers H1 (bold 60.7 / 65.6) re-set as a cover: a field square for the figure, the title scaled to 54.
measured: Article H1 sans 700 35.9 / 40.9, body serif 17 / 26 in 720, lede serif 28 / 36; careers H1 sans 700 60.7 / 65.6, lede serif 22 / 31.9.
Template: three title lines of 10 characters fit; every subject passes.
